caption:
Mountain biking in Costa Rica will eventually ask you to step off the pedals. These mountain ridges were shaped by rainfall and old farm paths long before bicycles arrived, and some pitches simply demand hands on the handlebars and shoes in the grass. There is no hurry in walking the crest when the entire valley opens up below and the ocean breeze reaches the ridge. The mountain always gives back what it asks of your legs.
